entries.subject: planning
entries.cognitive_task: 根据每个原题小问给出的设施、案例、制度或空间条件，判断原题要求的术语、特征或正确叙述。
entries.knowledge_relation: 题干条件与答案索引所对应的设施特征、案例属性、制度或标准之间的原题关系。
entries.answer_basis: data/planning-exam-answers.json#2023:専門1:問題4；题干来自 data/processed_questions/2023_専門1_建筑计划_Q問題4.md。

entries.subject: building_construction
entries.cognitive_task: 根据 RC 躯体施工与纳まり的定义、构件作用、工序或缺陷关系，把唯一术语填入对应空位。
entries.knowledge_relation: RC construction statement → reviewed term, limited to the RC shared-word-bank relation pool.
entries.answer_basis: data/building-construction-rc-shared-wordbank-facts.json；结构依据为 2022 専門1 建築構法 Q3。

entries.subject: environment
entries.cognitive_task: 在定常、完全混合条件下，根据 CO₂ 发生量、室内浓度和室外浓度计算必要换气量。
entries.knowledge_relation: Q = G / (Ci - Co), with unit conversion from ppm to concentration fraction.
entries.answer_basis: data/processed_questions/2017_専門1_建筑环境工学_Q4.md；src/lib/environment-ventilation-generator.ts 的参数和单位验证。

entries.subject: history
entries.surface_format: image matching with two shared word banks
entries.cognitive_task: 将已审核建筑图片分别与建筑名称和建筑师对应，且在每个语群中排除不匹配图像的术语。
entries.knowledge_relation: image → building and image → architect, using reviewed image assets and approved entity relations.
entries.answer_basis: data/image-assets.json、data/history-text-review-status.json、data/atomic-facts.json；结构依据为 2019 専門1 建築史 Q5。

past_exam_trainer_coverage.scope: all readable 専門1 processed question blocks for history, planning, building_construction, and environment

level_rules.A: Reserved for an official answer record plus complete verified metadata and option evidence; none are asserted by this migration.
level_rules.B: A source-matched answer-index subquestion exists and is automatically graded; per-option negative evidence remains unresolved unless separately recorded.
level_rules.C: A readable original question block without a source-matched automatic answer/rubric; browse and self-evaluate only.

derivation.blocks: data/processed_questions/*.md, subject/category filtered at runtime; each block has explicit Level C unless a source-matched answer-index subquestion is selected.
derivation.planning: data/planning-exam-answers.json matched by fileName and indexed subquestion
derivation.building_construction: data/construction-exam-answers.json matched by fileName and expanded source slot
derivation.environment: src/lib/environment-review.ts ENVIRONMENT_REVIEW_RECORDS matched by fileName and segment key
derivation.history: src/lib/history-review.ts REVIEW_ANSWERS matched by fileName; essay/source gaps remain Level C where no formal scoring source exists

past_exam_trainer_coverage.unresolved_option_analysis_message: 现有资料仅能确认正确答案，尚无足够证据逐项解释其他选项。
